description: Shared Renovate policy for repos using ci-templates. Enable with {"extends": ["github>at-blacknight-projects/ci-templates"]}.

packageRules.description: aquasecurity's IP allow list refuses token-authenticated API calls from runners, even for public repos, so github-tags lookups return nothing. git ls-remote is allowed, so look their actions up as git tags.
Runtime dependencies change what ships, so they are fix(deps) and semantic-release cuts a patch release. Everything else (CI, tooling) stays chore(deps) and releases nothing.
The go directive is a minimum, not a pin; only the toolchain line moves.
Keep the Go toolchain line and the golang builder image on the same patch: official golang images set GOTOOLCHAIN=local, so go.mod alone can't raise the version an image builds with.
Group non-major GitHub Actions updates into one PR.
Group non-major Go module updates into one PR.
Merge non-major CI tooling updates on their own once the checks pass.
